method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05 (JUST FALSE where the text says no, NOTHING with a NOTHING-kind tag where it does not answer); one regulative rule (the other place's limitation period as s 5 applies it) run by EVALTRACE inside an exported question that takes only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.

scope: In: the whole operative Act, ss 3, 4, 5, 6, 7. Out: s 1 (name), s 2 (commencement; its date is an input), s 8 (the Minister's review): machinery. The choice of the governing law (general law) and the other place's limitation period (that place's law) are asked as facts. Reasons in NOTES.md.
